description: Presidential Secretariat - Declare that the Railway Services to be an Essential Public Service
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President declaring certain public services as "essential" under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. This constitutes a regulatory/legal action that modifies the legal status of these services and falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal notices), rather than being primarily about government personnel, structure, land, commerce, or other specialized categories.
